### About this portfolio

This portfolio documents my learning across both sections of the course. It contains:

- Four substantial projects ([links in the **Projects** tab](projects/index.qmd)), spanning model
  comparison, computational/statistical programming, and real-world data.
- Smaller pieces of work for each section — worked tutorials, implementations, and overviews
  ([**Section 1**](section-1/section-1.qmd) / [**Section 2**](section-2/section-2.qmd)).
- A [**journal**](journal/index.qmd) documenting my progress throughout the course.
- A [**reflective commentary**](reflective-commentary.qmd) (1000–2000 words) on my learning,
  methodological challenges, and ethical/reproducibility considerations.
- An [**AI use log**](ai-use-log.qmd) documenting substantive uses of AI tools.
- [**Reproducible code and data**](appendix/code-and-data.qmd) supporting the above.
